about_the_game: The Bare Witness Official Walkthrough is just the tool you'll need to navigate some of the trickier choices to attain some of the game's more obscure endings and achievements. This step-by-step guide will usher you to each of the 11 endings and every achievement in the game.

content_descriptors.notes: This walkthrough references both adult language and sexual content found in Bare Witness. These references include discussions and decisions involving the use of alcohol and/or illegal drugs, cursing, and various sex acts.
